title: 第17章 请殿下准许和离第18章 想和离得加钱
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
对于夏无恙的怀疑，仅仅持续了片刻，就已经没人理会。
不过是口角之争罢了，难道夏无恙还能因为这点儿小事，就杀了云舒公主不成？
况且就算夏无恙有这样的心思，他也没有相应的实力，根本杀不了云舒公主。
虽然也有人提出龟兹舞女进入东宫之事有蹊跷，可能跟云舒公主有关，会不会是因为此事，云舒公主才会出事。
但是想到文华殿中夜夜笙歌，对一群龟兹舞女宠爱万分的夏无恙，就没有人觉得云舒公主的死是夏无恙所为。
这个老东西如今已经糊涂了，看不出云舒公主这是在害他，说不定他知道了这件事情以后，不但不会怨恨云舒公主，还会感谢她给自己送来的龟兹舞女。
关于夏无恙的嫌疑，就这样被轻松洗刷，没有人再理会他，开始怀疑其他人。
“确是暗伤发作无疑。”老太医的银针在烛火上反复灼烧：“公主心脉有旧疾，恰如琉璃盏上的裂痕……”
这时候对于云舒公主的死亡调查也得出了初步结论，的确是暗伤发作导致云舒公主身死，而且这暗伤早有征兆，只是云舒公主没有在意。
却未曾想到会导致云舒公主以那么酷烈的方式，死在了彩云殿中。
类似的事情也不是没有发生过，不过以往都是发生在江湖上，皇子皇女们一个个娇生惯养，身边有太医伺候，很少出现这种事情，难免会惹人怀疑。
就连夏皇也派出高手协助调查，却也没有发现什么疑点，直到有人提出，这该不会是幽冥绝脉针所为。
毕竟若是想要做到这么天衣无缝，放眼整个大夏皇朝，似乎只有幽冥绝脉针能够实现，而且至少也要是大成以上的幽冥绝脉针。
听到这个判断，众多名捕、仵作、太医……面如土色，忙不迭地让提出这个判断的人闭嘴，不敢再说下去。
幽冥绝脉针乃是皇室秘传，能够修行者寥寥无几，更遑论是将其修行到大成之境的，每一位都是大夏皇室数得着的大人物。
难道这样的大人物，还会出手暗杀一个晚辈不成。
所以云舒公主肯定是暗伤发作暴毙而亡，绝不是幽冥绝脉针所为，自然跟夏无恙更没有什么关系。
此事的调查就这样不了了之，虽然还有一些疑点，却已经不重要了，很快夏皇就开始为其举行葬礼。
期间并未通报云舒公主乃是被他人所杀，只是说她暗伤发作而死，夏无恙还特意去了她的葬礼，向云舒公主做最后的告别。
不知道云舒公主泉下有知，会不会觉得感动，杀了她再参加她的葬礼，还睡着她千方百计送去的龟兹舞女，仔细算起来，云舒公主对他还挺不错。

暗杀云舒公主的事情，对夏无恙来说不过是个小插曲罢了，解决了这个疯癫的女人，以后也能够省很多事情。
他继续跟那些宫女和龟兹舞女夜夜笙歌，暗中却在不断修行提升，功法、战技、秘术……都在稳步增长，距离突破越来越近。
只不过外界并不知道他昏聩无能的外表下，隐藏着怎样的丘壑。
他们都觉得夏无恙这个老太子一天不如一天，距离死亡越来越近，很多东宫之人，都已经在找后路了，甚至还包括以前夏无恙颇为宠爱的星衍娘子。
content_en:
The doubts about Xia Wuyan only lasted for a moment and were ignored by no one.
It was just a verbal dispute. Could it be that Xia Wuyang killed Princess Yun Shu because of such a trivial matter?
Moreover, even if Xia Wuchang had such thoughts, he did not have the corresponding strength and could not kill Princess Yun Shu at all.
Although some people have suggested that there is something fishy about the Qiuci dancer entering the East Palace, and it may be related to Princess Yunshu. Could it be because of this that something happened to Princess Yunshu?
But when they think of Xia Wuhuang, who sang and sang every night in the Wenhua Palace and doted on a group of Qiuci dancers, no one thought that Princess Yunshu's death was Xia Wuhuang's fault.
This old guy is confused now and cannot see that Princess Yunshu is trying to harm him. Maybe after he finds out about this, not only will he not resent Princess Yunshu, but he will also thank her for sending him the Qiuci dancer.
The suspicion about Xia Wuyang was easily washed away. No one paid attention to him anymore and began to doubt others.
"It is undoubtedly a hidden injury." The old doctor's silver needle burned repeatedly on the candlelight: "The princess's heart veins have an old disease, just like the cracks on the glass cup..."
At this time, the investigation into Princess Yunshu's death also came to a preliminary conclusion. It was indeed the hidden injury that caused Princess Yunshu's death. Moreover, there were signs of this hidden injury, but Princess Yunshu did not pay attention to it.
But he never thought that Princess Yun Shu would die in such a cruel way in Caiyun Palace.
It is not that similar things have never happened, but in the past they always happened in the arena. The princes and princesses were pampered and pampered one by one, and they were attended by imperial doctors. This kind of thing rarely happened, and it would inevitably arouse people's suspicion.
Even Emperor Xia sent experts to assist in the investigation, but nothing suspicious was found until someone suggested that this could not be the work of the Netherworld Jueming Needle.
After all, if you want to achieve such a seamless performance, looking at the entire Great Xia Dynasty, it seems that only the Netherworld Absolute Meridian Needle can achieve it, and at least it must be a Netherworld Absolute Meridian Needle that is above Dacheng.
After hearing this judgment, many famous arresters, widowers, and imperial doctors... their faces turned pale, and they hurriedly told the person who made this judgment to shut up, not daring to say any more.
The Netherworld Absolute Meridian Needle is a secret passed down by the royal family. There are only a few people who can practice it, let alone those who can practice it to a great level. Each one of them is a big shot in the Daxia royal family.
Could it be that such a big shot would assassinate a junior?
Therefore, Princess Yunshu must have died suddenly due to a hidden injury. It was definitely not caused by the Netherworld Jueming Needle, and it certainly had nothing to do with Xia Wuyan.
The investigation of this matter ended like this. Although there were still some doubts, they were no longer important. Soon Emperor Xia began to hold a funeral for him.
During this period, it was not reported that Princess Yun Shu was killed by someone else. It was only said that she died of a hidden injury. Xia Wuyang even went to her funeral to say his final farewell to Princess Yun Shu.
I wonder if Princess Yunshu knew about it and would feel moved. He killed her and then attended her funeral, and even slept with the Qiuci dancer she tried every means to send. After careful calculation, Princess Yunshu was quite good to him.
The assassination of Princess Yunshu was just a minor episode for Xia Wuyang. Dealing with this crazy woman would save a lot of trouble in the future.
He continued to sing and sing with the palace maids and Kucha dancers every night, but secretly he continued to practice and improve. His skills, combat skills, and secret techniques... were all increasing steadily, and he was getting closer and closer to a breakthrough.
It's just that the outside world doesn't know what kind of troubles are hidden under his dim and incompetent appearance.
They all felt that Xia Wuyang, the old prince, was getting worse day by day and that he was getting closer and closer to death. Many people in the East Palace were already looking for a way out, including Lady Xingyan, whom Xia Wuyang loved in the past.
